title: Case 023: Balcony Door Lock Repair
initial_request: The tenant has reported that the locking mechanism on the glass door which leads out to the balcony is not turning / locking. Can you please get in touch with them to schedule a date and time to attend the property and quote to have the issue resolved. Thank you.
overview: The tenant reported that the balcony-door lock would not turn or lock. The landlord approved arranging a repair, and Northbridge Lettings assigned Juniper Surveying. The provider tried to contact the tenant to arrange access, later confirmed the job was done and the invoice had been sent. Final checks, including confirmation that the keys were returned, were completed and the request was closed.
outcome: The provider confirmed the balcony-door repair was completed and the invoice had been sent. The request was closed after final checks and confirmation of the key return.
